source_caption_text:
Drake missing the “POPSTAR” video shoot gave us one of the iconic music videos ever 😭

Drake was apparently running late for the “POPSTAR” video shoot, so instead of waiting around, the team called Justin Bieber to step in for him. Somehow, that ended up being one of the funniest music video decisions ever.

Bieber fully committed to the role, lip-syncing Drake’s verses while walking around a massive mansion in fur coats and designer fits. He really looked like he was having the time of his life pretending to be Drake.

What could’ve been a production headache turned into one of the most memorable parts of the whole song. Drake didn’t even have to show up, because Justin Bieber basically took over the entire video.
